ug_missing-0.title: Lost in the Paris catacombs (1793)
ug_missing-0.place: Catacombs of Paris, under the Val-de-Grâce hospital, France
ug_missing-0.summary: Philibert Aspairt, a doorkeeper at the Val-de-Grâce hospital, went down a staircase into the old quarry tunnels in November 1793, reportedly looking for wine or liquor, and never came out. His body was found in 1804 in one of the galleries and buried where it lay. The cause of death was never determined.
evidence: His tomb remains in a restricted part of the catacombs.

ug_missing-1.title: Tham Luang cave rescue (2018)
ug_missing-1.place: Tham Luang Nang Non cave, Chiang Rai province, Thailand
ug_missing-1.summary: Twelve boys from a youth football team and their assistant coach went missing after heavy rain flooded the cave behind them on 23 June 2018. British divers found them alive on 2 July on a rock ledge about 2 km from the entrance, and an international operation brought all 13 out. A former Thai Navy SEAL diver died during the rescue.

ug_missing-2.place: San José mine, Atacama Desert, Chile

ug_missing-4.title: Lassing mine disaster (1998)
ug_missing-4.summary: A mudslide broke into a talc mine and trapped one miner. A ten-man rescue team went in the same day and vanished when a second mudslide collapsed the mine. The trapped miner was found alive after ten days, the "Miracle of Lassing". The ten rescuers were declared dead and the search for them was called off in 2000.

ug_missing-8.place: Mossdale Caverns, Yorkshire Dales, England, UK
ug_missing-8.summary: Six cavers were trapped when rain flooded the only entrance. Rescuers could not get in until the next day; five bodies were found in the far crawls and the sixth a day later.
